newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan Bourse Fib30 index hits new record high.
newsitem.headline: Milan Bourse Fib30 index hits new record high.

text.p: The Milan Bourse Fib30 stock index September futures contract touched a new record high of 22,950 in first trading, before slipping back.
At 0734 GMT, the September contract was 0.05 percent up at 22,750. It closed on Thursday at 22,739.
The Milan stock exchange closed at all-time highs on Thursday, boosted by a flood of buying from home and abroad.
